signal: Nowsta launched Staffing Labs and an AI-driven workforce platform after raising $35M Series C ($93M total)

email.body1:
AJ, saw Nowsta launched Staffing Labs and is scaling the AI workforce platform after the Series C.

A new offering plus a raise usually opens more strategic enterprise accounts than the team can cover before the motion ramps, and that is where the biggest deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nowsta off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
AJ, quick follow-up for Nowsta enterprise.

Post-raise, board expectations on strategic pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most enterprise teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
AJ, last bit of proof for Nowsta.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nowsta's enterprise reply rate likely compares to other workforce tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
AJ, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a raise and a launch, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Nowsta either way.
